candidate_grammar.boundary: Every positive finite QCPLXX-007 input, execution, resource, decision, comparison and registered finite-to-asymptotic or physical boundary.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete eight-axis QCPLXX-007 product before observation access.
candidate_grammar.unique_survivor: QCPLXX-007 uniquely retains resource-bounded-accept-reject-support, complete resource custody, root forcing, post-registry execution and no extra rule.

excluded_inputs: no imported complexity class, stochastic error premise, asymptotic theorem or lower bound selects the law
host 0 denotes absence only and is not a numerical-zero input, resource or probability
no negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, fitted or completed-infinite proof scalar
no mismatched problem grammar, hidden cost, sampled case or target-selected comparison
no physical device performance is inferred without its owning measurement handoff
no first failure retires an obligation or changes the protected authority
statement: A quantum decision or recognition class is a set of canonical inputs whose complete executions meet a registered accept/reject support condition inside an exact resource bound.
